implemented_tests.name: minimal_thrend
implemented_tests.notes: Generated-candidate minimal QPU user-program launch/completion test: thread end plus delay slots, no memory output. Requires completed_qpus=12, zero launch failures, and one generated runtime launch.

implemented_tests.name: memory_output
implemented_tests.notes: Generated-candidate QPU memory-output test: each active QPU writes one 16-lane u32 vector through VPM/VDW to host-visible memory, with exact host oracle, guard checks, and runtime launch counters.

implemented_tests.name: read_nop_write
implemented_tests.notes: Generated-candidate QPU read-nop-write test: copies one 16-lane u32 vector per active QPU from host input to host output through VDR DMA load, VPM read/write, and VDW DMA store, with exact host oracle and guard checks.

implemented_tests.name: tmu_read_nop_write
implemented_tests.notes: Generated-candidate TMU0 direct-memory read counterpart to read_nop_write; copies one 16-lane u32 vector per active QPU from input to result via TMU read and VPM/VDW store, with exact host oracle and guard checks.

implemented_tests.name: saxpy_tmu
implemented_tests.notes: TMU-backed basic SAXPY golden: direct TMU0 reads for x/y, fmul/fadd arithmetic, VPM/VDW result store. Current scheduled input intentionally serializes each TMU request/read pair; overlapping TMU requests should be covered by a later scheduled-overlap test.

implemented_tests.name: saxpy_tmu_overlap
implemented_tests.notes: Overlapped-TMU SAXPY reference: issues independent TMU0 direct-memory requests for x and y before consuming both results, computes y = alpha * x + y, and stores through VPM/VDW. Candidate side disabled until codegen exists.

implemented_tests.name: sfu_recip
implemented_tests.notes: Generated-candidate SFU reciprocal test. Exercises SFU_RECIP write/readback through r4 with the required two-instruction r4 dead window before the N+3 read; oracle compares against host reciprocal with a tight VC4 SFU approximation bound.

implemented_tests.name: qpu_num_register
implemented_tests.notes: Exploratory hardware-run test that queues 16 QPU user-program requests and records the hardware QPU_NUMBER/qpu_num register observed by each dispatched kernel. The oracle requires 16 completed requests, no pending output slots, and observed values in the architectural 4-bit QPU-number range; it deliberately does not pin scheduler assignment order or observed qpu_mask.

implemented_tests.name: saxpy_full
implemented_tests.notes: Tail-safe SAXPY hardware-run candidate. Builds input.mlir into a generated VC4 bundle and computes y[i] = alpha * x[i] + y[i] for varied n values including zero, short tails, vector boundaries, QPU-round boundaries, and n=1000. The harness checks 4,795 live outputs exactly, verifies a guard tail, and requires runtime launch/code-upload counters.

implemented_tests.name: matmul_naive
implemented_tests.notes: Naive CUDA-shaped matrix multiplication hardware-run reference for C[M,N] = A[M,K] * B[K,N]. Exercises TMU direct loads, QPU floating-point accumulation, tail-safe column stores through VPM/VDW, and logical work distribution across active QPUs. The reference launcher uses one GPU allocation/code copy during runtime setup and updates already allocated uniforms/payloads for repeated launch cases. Candidate/codegen side remains disabled.
